edits.headline: Trump says Iran war will end right after the midterm elections
edits.subheadline: Trump told Fox News he did not regret starting the war and would make the same decision again, Business Today reported.
editorialBody: US President Donald Trump said he believed the war with Iran would end right after the November midterm elections, in a Fox News interview reported by Business Today on 11 September.
"I don't believe in the word 'regret'," Trump said. He also said Iran was trying to influence the midterms.

Trump said Ukraine should stop striking Russian diesel production, the Associated Press reported on 14 September. "Mr Zelenskyy has to do one thing. He has to stop knocking out diesel fuel in Russia," he said at the Irish Open at his Doonbeg golf club.
One person was killed and four were injured when an Iranian commercial vessel was hit off Qeshm Island on 13 September, Press TV reported. Iranian officials blamed US and Israeli forces.
The UN General Assembly's high-level general debate begins in New York on 22 September.
